app_fee.value: The non-refundable graduate application fee is $90 for applicants with international credentials ($55 for others).

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are need-based, for applicants from economically disadvantaged backgrounds; you request one from Graduate Admissions.
fee_waiver.quote: Graduate application fee waivers are granted based on evidence of financial need and are intended to assist applicants from economically disadvantaged backgrounds in pursuing graduate admission

also.quote: To request a fee waiver, please contact Graduate Admissions.

gre_general.value: There is no university-wide GRE rule; some programs require it, so see each program record.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 4 overall (new scale) for tests taken after January 21, 2026; the old minimum was 78.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with at least 6.0 in each section.
ielts_min.quote: 6.5 overall with minimum section scores of

english_waiver.value: The waiver depends on a country list that does not name India on the fetched page, so an English waiver for Indian applicants is not confirmed.

notes: Graduate College rules. Program pages restate the fee and English minimums; GRE is set per program.
